name: Rainforest API
summary: Real-time Amazon product data from Traject Data's Rainforest API: product pages, search results, seller offers, bestseller lists and search suggestions on every Amazon domain, as structured JSON.

api_key.description: A Rainforest API key (app.rainforestapi.com), sent as the api_key query parameter.

notes: Every call is GET /request with type naming the data; each endpoint here fixes type.
Billed in credits: 1 per page retrieved, more for some options; request_info.credits_used and credits_remaining in each answer show the cost.
Give asin (or gtin) with amazon_domain. The vendor's url parameter, which takes a raw Amazon page URL, is left out.
Calls are run against Amazon in real time when made, not served from a stored index.

endpoints.name: Get an Amazon product
endpoints.summary: The product page of one ASIN as structured data: title, price and buybox, ratings, images, variants and more.

amazon_domain.description: Amazon site, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de (see the supported domains list).

gtin.description: GTIN, ISBN, UPC or EAN, converted to an ASIN first; use with amazon_domain.

fields.description: Comma-separated product fields to keep, dot notation for nested ones.

include_summarization_attributes.description: Add the per-attribute ratings and customers_say summary.

variant_prices.description: Add each variant's price; costs 2 credits instead of 1.

language.description: Display language of the Amazon page.

currency.description: Currency to request the Amazon page in.

customer_location.description: Country the page is viewed from, for cross-border prices and shipping.

notes: asin or gtin is required (one of them), or the call is a 400.
1 credit per call; variant_prices, include_safety_product_resources and similar options cost more, as listed per option. A gtin lookup is cached for 2 months.

endpoints.name: Search Amazon products
endpoints.summary: Search results for a term on one Amazon site: position, ASIN, title, price, rating, sponsored flag.

amazon_domain.description: Amazon site, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de (see the supported domains list).

category_id.description: Category id to search within (from the Categories API).

refinements.description: Comma-separated refinement values returned in a previous search's refinements array.

exclude_sponsored.description: Leave sponsored results out; default false.

direct_search.description: Do not let Amazon auto-correct the spelling.

number_of_results.description: How many results to return, at most what the page shows.

page.description: Page to fetch; see pagination.total_pages in the answer.

max_page.description: Fetch pages 1..N and join them; each page fetched is a credit.

language.description: Display language of the Amazon page.

currency.description: Currency to request the Amazon page in.

customer_location.description: Country the page is viewed from, for cross-border prices and shipping.

notes: 1 credit per page fetched (max_page multiplies it); include_products_count, which runs product calls for top results, is left out because each one is another credit.

endpoints.summary: The seller offers for one ASIN, filterable by condition, Prime and free shipping.

gtin.description: GTIN, ISBN, UPC or EAN, converted to an ASIN first; use with amazon_domain.

show_different_asins.description: Include offers Amazon shows for other ASINs (e.g. when this one is out of stock).

page.description: Page to fetch; see pagination.total_pages in the answer.

max_page.description: Fetch pages 1..N and join them; each page fetched is a credit.

language.description: Display language of the Amazon page.

currency.description: Currency to request the Amazon page in.

customer_location.description: Country the page is viewed from, for cross-border prices and shipping.

notes: asin or gtin is required (one of them), or the call is a 400.

endpoints.name: Get an Amazon bestsellers list
endpoints.summary: Ranked bestsellers of one Amazon category, with ASIN, title, price and rating.

amazon_domain.description: Amazon site, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de (see the supported domains list).

category_id.description: Bestsellers category id from the Categories API.

top_free.description: The Top 100 Free list instead of Paid, where a category has both.

page.description: Page to fetch; see pagination.total_pages in the answer.

max_page.description: Fetch pages 1..N and join them; each page fetched is a credit.

language.description: Display language of the Amazon page.

currency.description: Currency to request the Amazon page in.

customer_location.description: Country the page is viewed from, for cross-border prices and shipping.

endpoints.name: Get Amazon search suggestions
endpoints.summary: The search-box suggestions Amazon shows for a typed term.

amazon_domain.description: Amazon site, e.g. amazon.com, amazon.co.uk, amazon.de (see the supported domains list).

autocomplete_alias.description: Department to scope suggestions to; default all departments.
